summary: Meta-Magic: the next Enchantment, Magic Ball or Verbal may be cast while moving.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: Applies only to the next Enchantment, Magic Ball or Verbal. The target indication and 'Ambulant' itself may also be said while moving; other Meta-Magics may not.

requirements.note: Only the next Enchantment, Magic Ball or Verbal.

properties.note: Ambulant itself and the target indication may be said while moving (not other Meta-Magics).

references.name: meta-magic
references.note: Type is Meta-Magic; N1 excludes other Meta-Magics from being said while moving.

references.name: incantation
references.note: Target indication and the Meta-Magic word are said while moving.

clarifications.text: Both the target indication and 'Ambulant' may be said while moving, but other Meta-Magics used with it may not.
